free_tier.stated: The page states unlimited storage, anonymous use and no speed limit on the free Regular plan, which shows full advertisement and a captcha. The unlimited claim is not measured.

retention.stated: Free Regular plan: files deleted 15 days after last download. Premium: files never deleted if shared.

egress.terms: Free Regular plan: downloads go through a landing page with a captcha and full advertisement; no speed limit is claimed and no GB meter is published.

tooling: No documented API; the endpoints found in the page source (/api/complete, /api/get, /api/upload-url) reject naive curl with an HTML error page, so a browser/session is required.
chaining: Anonymous, no-mail, no-size-limit uploads — the same shape as Buzzheavier/ZeroFS. Retention policy is unpublished, which is the risk.

limits.value: free Regular plan: files deleted 15 days after last download

limits_note: Unpublished per-file and retention terms; only the marketing claims are visible without a session.

identity_cost.detail: The page states that no email is required to upload.

reliability_note: Cannot be verified past the landing page: no FAQ, no terms, upload endpoints return 'File not found' HTML to scripted POSTs. Treat the unlimited claim as unverified marketing.
confidence_note: page read on 2026-11-03: vikingfile.com (landing page: Unlimited storage, Anonymous, No speed limit, No mail required; REGULAR is Free with Full advertisement, Landing page for download, Captcha, Files deleted 15 days after last download; PREMIUM is 10 € / month with Files never deleted if shared). Upload endpoints were not probed on 2026-11-03 and the unlimited-storage claim is not measured.
